description: WitCloud connects ChatGPT to your marketing, sales, and ecommerce data. Ask questions in plain language and get answers straight from your business data - explore customers, campaigns, revenue, and trends without writing SQL. WitCloud uses your business context to keep answers relevant. All access is read-only.
